verdicts.reason: A rebuilds the skyscraper well: badge, then headline, subhead, phone and a big full-width 'Try It' button, so the CTA stays prominent. But a stray clipped cream circle sits in the bottom-left corner, the badge is jammed against the top edge, and 'now.' is left as an orphan. B buries the CTA: 'Try It' has shrunk to a tiny pill crammed into the bottom-left corner, overlapping the same clipped cream circle. The 'ONLINE ONLY' badge, now below the phone, outweighs the button, so the hierarchy is wrong.
